newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL still a Fator hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL still a Fator hold.

text.p: -- Banco Fator said it was maintaining its hold recommendation for Brazilian state power firm Companhia Paulista expected rise in first-quarter earnings.
-- Fator analyst Terezinha Moniz cited CPFL's first-quarter net income, which she said was 72 percent above the bank's expectations and 49 percent higher than first-quarter 1996.
-- "Despite these good results and the prospect of them continuing for the rest of the year, we are maintaining our hold recommendation," Moniz said in a report.
-- "This is because of the share's low upside potential in terms of CPFL's potential privatization value which we estimate at 2.8 billion reais," she wrote.
-- She added current market capitalization is already higher than that figure.
-- Moniza added that a 4.5 percent rise in consumption in first-quarter 1997 confirms projected annual growth of 5.5 percent.
-- She said the average tariff in the first quarter was 72.32 reais per megawatt hour (MWh) compared with 77.50 reais in 1996's first quarter.
-- CPFL was up 3.4 percent at 167.50 reais and its preferred share was flat at 150 reais at 1644 local/1544 EDT on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
